author: GamingBolt
description:
Shrek 2 Remastered has a certain amount of charm to it that fans of the Shrek movies will appreciate. There is fun to be had here, especially when played with friends. 

Sadly however, its outdated mechanics and frustrating camera prevent it from being a great experience. In summary there is little here to justify this remaster’s existence beyond a fresh coat of paint. 

Fans of the original may find more to appreciate, but newcomers will likely struggle to overlook its multitude of shortcomings.
title: Shrek 2 Remastered Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
With GTA 6 now firmly on its way to finally being in our hands in just under a week, our thoughts go to what Rockstar might be thinking of doing after its latest flagship is let loose into the world. 

Building that flagship has taken valuable time, and Rockstar has revealed their valuable lessons learned along the way in the course of the game’s official coverage. 

How are those lessons going to be used to create the next big worlds from Rockstar? Which are probably going to be Red Dead Redemption 3 and Grand Theft Auto 7? What has making GTA 6 brought to the table to ensure we don’t have another long wait for news of a new game from Rockstar ahead of us? We’ve tried to answer all of these questions and more in an examination of what the future holds for one of gaming’s biggest names.

title: GTA 6 Could Be The BIG Reason Rockstar's Next Game Comes Sooner
